title: Preview activation
description: The control plane's answer to POST /v1/preview/activations, returned to the browser SDK bootstrap unchanged. It is the browser-observation activation response: browser-observation/activation-response/v1 owns the payload and the SDK verifies all three envelopes with a packaged public key. The door never mints, inspects, or caches them, and carries no envelope discriminator of its own because the document is the browser's.

attestation.description: Detached Ed25519 signature over a base64url JSON payload, relayed to the browser exactly as the control plane issued it. Owned by browser-observation/common/v1#/$defs/signed_envelope.
